title: My Pet Cat
description: A child describes a lazy pet cat called Coco.
instructions: Read the text about a pet cat, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: I have a pet cat. Her name is Coco. She is white with black ears. She is two years old.
Coco sleeps a lot. In the morning, she sleeps on my bed. In the afternoon, she sleeps in a box near the window. She is very lazy!
In the evening, Coco is awake. She plays with a small ball. She eats fish from her bowl. Then she sits on my lap and purrs.
We got Coco from a friend. Her cat had four kittens. Coco was the smallest one. She was very tiny and she had blue eyes. Now her eyes are green. She came to our house when she was ten weeks old.
Coco does not like water. When it rains, she stays inside the house. She also does not like the vacuum cleaner. It is too loud. When my mum cleans the floor, Coco runs under the bed.

Every Saturday, I brush Coco's fur. She sits still and closes her eyes. She likes it a lot. Once a year, we take her to the animal doctor. She does not like the car trip! The doctor says she is a healthy cat.
Coco is part of our family. My little brother draws pictures of her. My dad says she is the boss of the house. At night, she sleeps on my bed again. I love my lazy cat.
